superseded_attempts.reason: Superseded, not banked. 25 of 26 lanes passed at this commit; the report-parity lane's psdirect push of its 1.45 MB archive hung (Copy-Item -ToSession from the Linux controller stalls above roughly 256 KB) and was killed, and a re-run alone hung the same way. The transport fix (WI-078) changed scripts/windows-oracle/psdirect.ps1, which every lane binds, so every verdict of this attempt stopped binding before it could be banked. Its evidence tags are kept as history; its packs are not in the repository.

killed.name: report-parity
killed.reason: Killed by the operator (SIGTERM, exit 143) after the PowerShell Direct push of the 1.5 MB candidate archive to LabMS01 stalled for 60 minutes on an idle WinRM connection; the guest itself was healthy. psdirect.ps1 push/exec has no wall-clock timeout and the driver has no per-lane timeout (WI-078). No run directory, no verdict and no evidence tag were produced.
